task_description: Build a complete full-stack GeoGuessr-like web application called GeoGuess with Next.js frontend, Express backend, SQLite database, dark gaming UI theme, multiple game modes, scoring system, and pre-seeded location database.

verification.summary: pnpm run build succeeds (shared, server, client all compile). pnpm run test passes all 42 tests (scoring: 27, gameManager: 15, locationPicker: 5). No Docker available. Review fixes applied: combo multiplier capped at 2.0, auto-submit on hardcore timer expiry, country streak no longer writes fake coordinates.
